preflight.onDifferentCounterOrPendingRole: STOP; no automatic extra SET, budget expansion or replay

newSessionGuard.initialState: disabled until exact version and evidence match
newSessionGuard.retention: Keep old journals and new immutable audit; no auto-delete, counter reset or reservation refund. Separate measured metadata from held ceilings.
newSessionGuard.gateRouting: Fresh fixture-session gate only, namespace-isolated from expired fixture_budget/migration_gate rows; exact mapping must be reviewed/tested locally before SHA pinning. No application authorization gate bypass.

matrix.variant: validator only; no new full/control A/B in this session
matrix.trueCold: Opportunistic only within existing request budget, using isolateFirst+tag/version evidence. Readiness warms an isolate; no promised cold cells or extra deploy to force them.
matrix.statistics: Individual samples/range, no reliable p95; no subtraction across unequal isolate/cache states

steps: one atomic fixture guard/schema+session seed call
one bounded invocation CPU logs query after closure

cumulativeCeilings.calculation: HTTP=73 control cap+44 historical workload+13 new; reads=892 historical holds+12*64+256; writes=401 historical holds+12*32+64. Caps are not measured/billed usage or account-wide daily remainder.

evidenceAndStops.CPU: Cloudflare invocation cpuTimeMs joined by case and runtime version; latency separate; missing trace=inconclusive
stop: any quota/exceededCpu/provider error, timeout, unknown outcome, correctness/version/audit mismatch
any invocation cpuTimeMs>10ms under existing pilot criterion
any declared per-request/session/global cap exceeded or unverifiable
guard or readiness lease expires; no auto-renew
missing CPU after one bounded logs query =>inconclusive, no extra probes
evidenceAndStops.cleanup: Finally disable and GET-verify workers.dev=false/previews=false, up to one additional disable+verify pair; report immediately if unverified
evidenceAndStops.noFollowup: No Google transport, production cutover, benchmark rerun or CPU configuration change
evidenceAndStops.CPUDecisionTiming: cpuTimeMs is evaluated after the single post-closure logs query; >10ms is a session no-go, not a promised real-time abort.
